name: poly-transpose-follow
description: Track transpose/shift (FUN_08028194) walks the 128 mono step notes and adds a delta. This hook at 0x08028224 runs only on the success path, reproduces strh r4,[ip,#0x38], recovers the track index by matching ip against the track table (pattern sub-struct = track + index*0x194), then adds the same delta to every note in that track's poly record (clamped 0..127). Chords now follow transpose/scale shifts applied on the module.

patches.note: after successful mono transpose, shift the same track's chord notes
